Response.title: VTC Rooms Community Get — response payload
Response.description: Success response to vtc/rooms/community/get. Type https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/rooms/community/get/0.6#response. One room the community owns, in any state of its owner's lifecycle, with its counts, its signal delay and the record members its profile lists. Its members are vtc/rooms/community/members/list's.

signalDelay.description: The room's signal delay as the community applies it, as host, to the room's `rooms/changed` signals. Always present; a room that never set one is `randomised`. Changed with vtc/rooms/community/update.

recordMembers.description: The record members the room's profile listed when the community last wrote it or read it back — the community's own knowledge of the profile, not a read made for this request; a member holding `curate` may have written another set since. Absent when the profile listed none, or the community has not yet written one.
